summary.text: Curtis Trent is a Republican member of the Missouri Senate for District 20 in southwest Missouri, first elected in 2022, and serves as Assistant Majority Floor Leader.
His official Senate page says he took the oath of office on January 4, 2023, after six years in the Missouri House of Representatives, and lists him as chair of the General Laws Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Senate biography says Trent is an attorney who practiced administrative law concerning estate planning and probate and served as deputy chief of staff to the congressman from Missouri's 7th District.
It says he graduated summa cum laude from Missouri State University and holds a law degree from the Saint Louis University School of Law.
